{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Preview Backend

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - "dotnet/**"
      - "frontend/**"
      - "setup.ps1"
      - "setup.json"
      - "global.json"
      - "*.slnx"
      - "*.slnf"
      - ".github/actions/build-guacd/**"
      - ".github/workflows/preview-backend.yaml"

  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - "dotnet/**"
      - "frontend/**"
      - "setup.ps1"
      - "setup.json"
      - "global.json"
      - "*.slnx"
      - "*.slnf"
      - ".github/actions/build-guacd/**"
      - ".github/workflows/preview-backend.yaml"

  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency: preview-backend-${{ github.ref }}

jobs:
  build-guacd:
    name: Build guacd WSL distribution
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    # a pull_request from a branch in THIS repo is redundant since the push event already fires
    if: >-
      ${{ (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository) ||
      github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Build guacd WSL distribution
        id: guacd
        uses: ./.github/actions/build-guacd

      - name: Upload guacd.wsl artifact
        id: upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: guacd.wsl
          path: ${{ steps.guacd.outputs.guacd_path }}
          archive: false

  test-server:
    name: Test server (backend)
    runs-on: windows-latest

    # a pull_request from a branch in THIS repo is redundant since the push event already fires
    if: >-
      ${{ (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository) ||
      github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}

    env:
      NUGET_PACKAGES: ${{ github.workspace }}/.nuget/packages

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        if: ${{ !env.ACT }}
        with:
          global-json-file: global.json
          cache: false

      - name: Cache NuGet packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ env.NUGET_PACKAGES }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-${{ hashFiles('**/packages.lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-

      - name: Restore .NET solution
        run: dotnet restore RAWeb.Server.slnf --locked-mode

      - name: Build .NET solution
        run: dotnet build RAWeb.Server.slnf --no-restore --configuration Release

      - name: Test .NET solution
        if: ${{ !env.ACT }} # act does not run in a separate environment as an admin account
        run: dotnet test RAWeb.Server.slnf --no-build --configuration Release -- --report-trx --coverage

      - name: Find HTML test report
        if: always()
        id: find-report
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $report = Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter "*-report.html" | Select-Object -First 1
          echo "path=$($report.FullName)" >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Upload HTML test report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: always() && steps.find-report.outputs.path != ''
        with:
          name: TestReport
          path: ${{ steps.find-report.outputs.path }}
          archive: false

  build-server:
    name: Build server (backend)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    needs: [build-guacd, test-server]

    # a pull_request from a branch in THIS repo is redundant since the push event already fires
    if: >-
      ${{ (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository) ||
      github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}

    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write # required for SignPath
      actions: write # required to delete temporary artifacts

    env:
      NUGET_PACKAGES: ${{ github.workspace }}/.nuget/packages
      SIGNPATH_ORGANIZATION_ID: b8f0ef72-143a-482d-b776-e08d26305b3c
      SIGNPATH_PROJECT_SLUG: raweb
      SIGNPATH_SIGNING_POLICY_SLUG: test-signing
      SIGNPATH_ARTIFACT_CONFIGURATION_SLUG_SERVER: raweb-server
      SIGNPATH_ARTIFACT_CONFIGURATION_SLUG_MANAGEMENT_SERVICE: raweb-management-service
      SIGNPATH_ARTIFACT_CONFIGURATION_SLUG_INSTALLER: raweb-installer

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Stub /bin/bash to system bash
        if: ${{ env.ACT }}
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # add the Git for Windows bin directory to the PATH
          "$env:ProgramFiles\Git\bin" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Encoding utf8 -Append

      - name: Set up pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
        with:
          version: 10.11
          run_install: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: "24.16.0"
          cache: "pnpm"
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cd frontend && pnpm install

      - name: Build the frontend
        run: cd frontend && pnpm run build
        env:
          RAWEB_SERVER_TYPE: aspnetcore

      - name: Set up .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        if: ${{ !env.ACT }}
        with:
          global-json-file: global.json
          cache: false

      - name: Cache NuGet packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ env.NUGET_PACKAGES }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-${{ hashFiles('**/packages.lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-

      - name: Restore .NET solution
        run: dotnet restore RAWeb.Server.slnf --locked-mode

      - name: Build .NET solution
        id: build
        run: |
          $version = [System.DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('yyyy.MM.dd.2HHmm') + "-unstable"
          dotnet publish RAWeb.Server.slnf --configuration Release --no-restore -p:FileVersion=$version
          echo "version=$version" >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Download guacd.wsl
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: guacd.wsl
          path: dotnet/RAWeb.Server/dist

      - name: Confirm guacd.wsl is present
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ ! -f "dotnet/RAWeb.Server/dist/guacd.wsl" ]; then
            echo "guacd.wsl not found in expected location: dotnet/RAWeb.Server/dist/guacd.wsl"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Sign raweb.exe
        uses: ./.github/actions/sign-exe-signpath
        with:
          name: raweb-server
          files: dotnet/RAWeb.Server/dist/raweb.exe
          api-token: ${{ secrets.SIGNPATH_API_TOKEN }}
          organization-id: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_ORGANIZATION_ID }}
          project-slug: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_PROJECT_SLUG }}
          signing-policy-slug: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_SIGNING_POLICY_SLUG }}
          artifact-configuration-slug: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_ARTIFACT_CONFIGURATION_SLUG_SERVER }}

      - name: Sign rawebmgmtsvc.exe
        uses: ./.github/actions/sign-exe-signpath
        with:
          name: raweb-management-service
          files: dotnet/RAWeb.Server/dist/rawebmgmtsvc.exe
          api-token: ${{ secrets.SIGNPATH_API_TOKEN }}
          organization-id: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_ORGANIZATION_ID }}
          project-slug: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_PROJECT_SLUG }}
          signing-policy-slug: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_SIGNING_POLICY_SLUG }}
          artifact-configuration-slug: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_ARTIFACT_CONFIGURATION_SLUG_MANAGEMENT_SERVICE }}

      - name: Move repository setup.ps1 to dotnet/RAWeb.Server/dist so it is included in the release archive
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mv setup.ps1 dotnet/RAWeb.Server/dist/setup.ps1

      # modify setup.ps1 to replace $source_dir = "dotnet\RAWeb.Server" with $source_dir = ""
      # since the setup.ps1 is now in the same folder as the files to install
      - name: Modify setup.ps1 for altered location
        shell: bash
        run: |
          find='$source_dir = "dotnet\\RAWeb.Server"'
          replace='$source_dir = ""'
          file='dotnet/RAWeb.Server/dist/setup.ps1'

          sed -i "s|$find|$replace|g" "$file"

      - name: Copy repository setup.json to dotnet/RAWeb.Server/dist so it is included in the release archive
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cp setup.json dotnet/RAWeb.Server/dist/setup.json

      # modify setup.json to replace "sourceRoot": ".\\dotnet\\RAWeb.Server\\dist" with "sourceRoot": "."
      # since setup.json is now in the same folder as the files to install
      - name: Modify setup.json for altered location
        shell: bash
        run: |
          find='"sourceRoot": ".\\\\dotnet\\\\RAWeb.Server\\\\dist"'
          replace='"sourceRoot": "."'
          file='dotnet/RAWeb.Server/dist/setup.json'

          sed -i "s|$find|$replace|g" "$file"

      - name: Generate archive
        uses: thedoctor0/zip-release@0.7.5
        with:
          type: "zip"
          directory: dotnet/RAWeb.Server/dist/
          filename: "../../../build/raweb_dev.zip"

      - name: Restore installer projects
        run: dotnet restore RAWeb.Server.Installer.slnf --locked-mode

      - name: Publish multi-version installer
        run: dotnet publish dotnet/RAWeb.Server.Installer/RAWeb.Server.Installer.csproj --configuration Release --no-restore -p:ReleaseRepository="${{ github.repository }}"

      - name: Sign multi-version installer
        uses: ./.github/actions/sign-exe-signpath
        with:
          name: raweb-installer
          files: "dotnet/RAWeb.Server.Installer/dist/Multi-version*.exe"
          api-token: ${{ secrets.SIGNPATH_API_TOKEN }}
          organization-id: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_ORGANIZATION_ID }}
          project-slug: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_PROJECT_SLUG }}
          signing-policy-slug: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_SIGNING_POLICY_SLUG }}
          artifact-configuration-slug: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_ARTIFACT_CONFIGURATION_SLUG_INSTALLER }}

      - name: Publish installer pinned to this preview build
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # this needs to be absolute paths
          distributables=$(realpath "build/raweb_dev.zip")

          # since we are providing distributables, the release tag is only used
          # as a version number that appears in the installer UI
          dotnet publish dotnet/RAWeb.Server.Installer/RAWeb.Server.Installer.csproj \
            --configuration Release --no-restore \
            -p:ReleaseRepository="${{ github.repository }}" \
            -p:EmbeddedReleaseTag="${{ steps.build.outputs.version }}" \
            -p:IncludeSourceRevisionInInformationalVersion=false \
            -p:EmbeddedDistributablesPath="$distributables"

      - name: Sign preview installer
        uses: ./.github/actions/sign-exe-signpath
        with:
          name: raweb-installer-preview
          files: "dotnet/RAWeb.Server.Installer/dist/Installer*.exe"
          api-token: ${{ secrets.SIGNPATH_API_TOKEN }}
          organization-id: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_ORGANIZATION_ID }}
          project-slug: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_PROJECT_SLUG }}
          signing-policy-slug: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_SIGNING_POLICY_SLUG }}
          artifact-configuration-slug: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_ARTIFACT_CONFIGURATION_SLUG_INSTALLER }}

      - name: Upload build output
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: build
          path: |
            ./build/raweb_dev.zip
          compression-level: 0 # no double-compressing (raweb_dev.zip is already a zip file)
          # note: we do not set archive: false here because it would break
          # the download process for this artifact in the install worker
          # (install.raweb.app/preview/owner/branch)

      - name: Upload multi-version installer
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: build
          path: dotnet/RAWeb.Server.Installer/dist/Multi-version*.exe
          archive: false

      - name: Upload preview version installer
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: build
          path: dotnet/RAWeb.Server.Installer/dist/Installer*.exe
          archive: false

  build-desktop-win:
    name: Build desktop app (Windows)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    needs: [test-server]

    # a pull_request from a branch in THIS repo is redundant since the push event already fires
    if: >-
      ${{ (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name != github.repository) ||
      github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}

    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write # required so SignPath can verify this workflow run as a trusted build system
      actions: write # required to delete temporary artifacts

    env:
      NUGET_PACKAGES: ${{ github.workspace }}/.nuget/packages
      SIGNPATH_ORGANIZATION_ID: b8f0ef72-143a-482d-b776-e08d26305b3c
      SIGNPATH_PROJECT_SLUG: raweb
      SIGNPATH_SIGNING_POLICY_SLUG: test-signing
      SIGNPATH_ARTIFACT_CONFIGURATION_SLUG_DESKTOP_INSTALLER: desktop-app-installer

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Stub /bin/bash to system bash
        if: ${{ env.ACT }}
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          # add the Git for Windows bin directory to the PATH
          "$env:ProgramFiles\Git\bin" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Encoding utf8 -Append

      - name: Set up pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
        with:
          version: 10.11
          run_install: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: "24.16.0"
          cache: "pnpm"
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cd frontend && pnpm install

      - name: Build the frontend
        run: cd frontend && pnpm run build
        env:
          RAWEB_SERVER_TYPE: aspnetcore

      - name: Set up .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        if: ${{ !env.ACT }}
        with:
          global-json-file: global.json
          cache: false

      - name: Cache NuGet packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ env.NUGET_PACKAGES }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-${{ hashFiles('**/packages.lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-

      - name: Restore .NET solution
        run: dotnet restore RAWeb.Desktop.slnf --locked-mode

      - name: Build .NET solution
        run: |
          $version = [System.DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('yyyy.MM.dd.2HHmm') + "-unstable" # 5-digit revision number that starts with 2 indicates an unstable build
          dotnet publish RAWeb.Desktop.slnf --configuration Release --no-restore -p:FileVersion=$version

      - name: Find generated installer .exe file
        id: find-installer
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $searchRoot = Join-Path $PWD "./dotnet/RAWeb.DesktopApp.Installer/dist"
          if (-not (Test-Path $searchRoot)) {
            Write-Error "Path not found: $searchRoot"
            exit 1
          }
          $installer = Get-ChildItem -Path $searchRoot -File -Filter "*.exe" |
            Select-Object -First 1
          if (-not $installer) {
            Write-Error "No installer .exe found under $searchRoot."
            exit 1
          }
          "path=$($installer.FullName)" >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Sign installer executable
        uses: ./.github/actions/sign-exe-signpath
        with:
          name: desktop-app-installer
          files: ${{ steps.find-installer.outputs.path }}
          api-token: ${{ secrets.SIGNPATH_API_TOKEN }}
          organization-id: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_ORGANIZATION_ID }}
          project-slug: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_PROJECT_SLUG }}
          signing-policy-slug: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_SIGNING_POLICY_SLUG }}
          artifact-configuration-slug: ${{ env.SIGNPATH_ARTIFACT_CONFIGURATION_SLUG_DESKTOP_INSTALLER }}

      - name: Upload installer
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: build
          path: ${{ steps.find-installer.outputs.path }}
          archive: false",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs .NET restore with --locked-mode in three jobs (test-server, build-server, build-desktop-win) on windows-latest, each fetching NuGet packages to a custom NUGET_PACKAGES directory. Evidence from P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern and experiment examples (pip and Go module caching) shows caching dependency downloads yields measurable savings (~6% elapsed time in experiments). The workflow already uses pnpm cache via setup-node for frontend dependencies, but .NET NuGet packages are not cached (setup-dotnet has cache: false). Adding actions/cache@v4 steps keyed on **/packages.lock.json before each restore preserves the locked-mode guarantee while avoiding repeated downloads. No contraindications apply: packages are immutable under --locked-mode, no equivalent cache exists, and required checks are unchanged.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9"]
}

Let me analyze the workflow and the evidence to determine if there's a suitable CI optimization.

The workflow is for "Preview Backend" and has several jobs:
1. build-guacd - builds guacd WSL distribution on ubuntu-latest
2. test-server - tests .NET solution on windows-latest
3. build-server - builds server (backend) on windows-latest, needs build-guacd and test-server
4. build-desktop-win - builds desktop app (Windows) on windows-latest, needs test-server

Looking at the evidence, I see several patterns:
- P-LIT-GHA-CACHE: Cache dependency downloads (has experimental evidence showing ~6% elapsed savings)
- P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE: Share cached build dependencies
- P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE: Cancel superseded runs (workflow already has concurrency: preview-backend-${{ github.ref }})
- P-LIT-FAIL-FAST: Cancel remaining matrix jobs after failure (no matrix in this workflow)
- P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT: Bound jobs with custom timeout
- P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST: Run previously failing jobs first
- P-LIT-UNUSED-DEP-SKIP: Evaluate skipping unused-dependency updates

The workflow already has concurrency control, so P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is already implemented.

Looking at the jobs, I see several places where dependency caching could help:
1. In test-server job: .NET restore (`dotnet restore RAWeb.Server.slnf --locked-mode`)
2. In build-server job: 
   - pnpm install for frontend (`cd frontend && pnpm install`)
   - .NET restore (`dotnet restore RAWeb.Server.slnf --locked-mode`)
   - .NET restore for installer (`dotnet restore RAWeb.Server.Installer.slnf --locked-mode`)
3. In build-desktop-win job:
   - pnpm install for frontend (`cd frontend && pnpm install`)
   - .NET restore (`dotnet restore RAWeb.Desktop.slnf --locked-mode`)

The workflow uses `actions/setup-node@v7` with `cache: "pnpm"` and `cache-dependency-path: frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml` for Node.js setup, which should cache pnpm dependencies. However, the `pnpm install` step still runs every time.

For .NET, the workflow uses `actions/setup-dotnet@v6` with `cache: false`, so no caching of NuGet packages.

The evidence shows P-LIT-GHA-CACHE has experimental evidence with ~6% elapsed savings for caching dependency downloads. The pattern is about caching dependency downloads rather than unchecked build outputs.

For this workflow, the most applicable would be caching NuGet packages for .NET and potentially pnpm dependencies (though pnpm cache is already configured in setup-node).

The workflow sets `NUGET_PACKAGES: ${{ github.workspace }}/.nuget/packages` which is a custom location. We could cache this directory.

Also, the pnpm cache is configured in setup-node but the `pnpm install` step still runs. The cache in setup-node caches the pnpm store, but `pnpm install` still needs to run to link dependencies. However, with a warm cache, `pnpm install` should be faster.

- Method: "Choose dependency download state rather than unchecked build outputs", "Keep installation and all required tests"

The experiment example shows adding a cache step before installing dependencies.

For this workflow, I think adding caching for NuGet packages would be beneficial. The workflow already has a custom NUGET_PACKAGES path, so we can cache that directory.

Let me also check if there are any contraindications: "Mutable or untrusted cached content", "An equivalent cache already exists". The NuGet packages are from a locked mode restore (--locked-mode), so they should be immutable based on the lock file.

The workflow uses `dotnet restore ... --locked-mode` which ensures the same packages are restored each time based on the lock file.

So I think adding a cache step for NuGet packages before the restore steps would be a good optimization.
